notes: Deal choice: the depositor Ford Credit Auto Receivables Two LLC (CIK 0001129987) files each deal's initial pool ABS-EE with the trust as co-registrant, one day before the preliminary prospectus (424H). Its submissions JSON lists pool ABS-EE filings on 2024-03-08 (2024-A), 2024-06-12 (2024-B), 2024-09-10 (2024-C), 2024-11-12 (2024-D), 2025-03-12 (2025-A), 2025-09-17 (2025-B), 2025-11-12 (2025-C) and 2026-03-11 (2026-A). Chosen: 2024-A (Jan-Jun 2024 window), 2025-A (the only deal in the Jan-Jun 2025 window) and 2025-C (the latest deal filed Oct 2025 - Feb 28 2026; 2026-A was filed 2026-03-11, after the cutoff). All are Ford Credit Auto Owner Trust retail loan deals; Ford's lease trusts (Ford Credit Auto Lease Trust, depositor Ford Credit Auto Lease Two LLC) were not used.

Ford files its final prospectus as a 424B2, not a 424B5. Receivable counts from the 424B2: 2024-A 46,551 (accession 0001104659-24-035482), 2025-A 45,722 (0001104659-25-026212), 2025-C 29,520 (0001104659-25-114588). For 2024-A and 2025-A the depositor filed two pool ABS-EEs the same day, one per offered deal size ('autoloaninitial<n>sp.xml' small pool and 'autoloaninitial<n>lp.xml' large pool); the large-pool files were parsed and their record counts equal the 424B2 counts. 2025-C has one pool file. The small-pool files were not downloaded.

Checks against the 424B2 (all exact, all three deals): rows parsed = receivable count; the sum of reportingPeriodActualEndBalanceAmount = initial pool balance to the cent ($1,696,683,364.30 / $1,668,378,947.84 / $1,096,614,974.63); the balance-weighted share of loans whose subvented values include '1' = 'Subvened-APR receivables' (76.54% / 75.19% / 68.93%); the balance-weighted share with new_used_code '1' = 'New vehicle' (92.68% / 94.25% / 93.70%). The balance column is not in the Parquet; these sums came from the XML (stats_<slug>.json has the balance sums).

subvented can repeat inside one loan (the XSD gives maxOccurs=unbounded and Ford writes both '1' and '2' for many loans). The parser keeps every value in file order joined by '|', so code_values_seen.subvented counts combinations such as '1|2'; subvented_each_code_seen counts single codes. Codes (XSD): 0 No, 1 Yes - Rate Subvention, 2 Yes - Cash Rebate, 98 Yes - Other. Ford's EX-103 (Asset Related Document): '1' = subvened-APR contract as described in the prospectus; '2' = the obligor received a cash rebate applied as a down payment.

credit_score_type is 'Consumer Bureau' or 'Commercial Bureau'. 'Consumer Bureau' scores are FICO Auto 8 scores (the 424B2 says Ford Credit uses FICO 8 auto scores, which range from 250 to 900): their counts in the bands >749, 700-749, 650-699, 600-649 and <600 equal the 424B2 'Distribution by FICO Score' table exactly in all three deals (2024-A: 23,137 / 6,570 / 4,962 / 2,730 / 1,283). Consumer scores run 424-900 (medians 772-774); 4,762 / 4,618 / 3,123 rows are above 850, which is normal on the 250-900 scale. 'Commercial Bureau' rows are the commercial-use receivables (424B2 'Commercial' row: 7,288 / 9,169 / 5,619; file: 7,285 / 9,173 / 5,619). Their scores are on a different, unstated scale (1 to 670, median 65-67, about 70% below 300) and must not be mixed with consumer FICO scores; the main session should keep credit_score_type == 'Consumer Bureau' when it needs a FICO score.
The string 'No Score' became NaN: 793 / 737 / 523 rows (Consumer Bureau 584 / 480 / 347, Commercial Bureau 209 / 257 / 176). The 424B2 'No FICO score' row has 581 / 484 / 347.

apr_pct is exactly 0 for 8,132 / 8,624 / 5,563 rows (17-19%); these are manufacturer-subvented 0% contracts. apr_pct maximum 24.99 / 25.14 / 20.89. interest_rate_type_code is '1' (fixed) for every row.

Pools are seasoned. Origination months: 2024-A 2017-03 to 2024-02 (57.1% originated in 2023, 12.7% in 2024); 2025-A 2018-04 to 2025-02 (51.0% in 2024, 5.7% in 2025); 2025-C 2018-11 to 2025-10 (39.8% in 2025, 29.9% in 2024). No loan was originated after 2026-01.

Ford EX-103 (ardinitretail2025cfinal.xml, read for 2025-C): original loan amount = amount financed; original interest rate = APR; original loan term counts a partial month as a month (so 61, 62, 73, 74 appear for 60- and 72-month contracts); new_used_code '1' includes most courtesy and demonstrator vehicles; vehicle_type_code '2' = light truck, '3' = utility; vehicle_value_source_code '98' is used for used vehicles even when Kelley Blue Book was consulted; income verification, employment verification and payment-to-income are omitted for commercial receivables whose primary obligor is a business entity (pti_pct is NaN for 7,657 / 9,528 / 5,866 rows) and PTI is also omitted when stated income is negligible.
vehicle_make is 'FORD' or 'LINC' (Lincoln) only; new_used_code '1' 41,890 / 41,886 / 26,877 rows and '2' 4,661 / 3,836 / 2,643.

Download method: parse_ford.py fetch, one request at a time with a 1-second pause, User-Agent from the SEC_UA environment variable (the CLAUDE.md string, which includes a contact and is not recorded in project files). Every XML size equals the size in the filing's index.json. Requests are logged in data/raw/ford/sec_requests.log (git-ignored).

data/raw/ford/sec/ holds the downloaded submissions JSON, filing index JSONs, the three 424B2 HTML files (about 14.6 MB) and the 2025-C EX-103. .gitignore excludes only *.xml and *.log here, so the HTML and JSON files are not ignored; the main session decides whether to commit them.
couldnt_confirm: Why the file's credit_score_type split differs from the 424B2 commercial / no-FICO rows by 3 loans in 2024-A and 4 loans in 2025-A (it matches exactly in 2025-C). I compared counts only; the 424B2 does not list loans.

The scale of 'Commercial Bureau' scores. Neither the 424B2 nor the 2025-C EX-103 describes it; the 424B2 says commercial-use obligors that are businesses are evaluated with commercial credit bureau information.
The small-pool XML files (2024-A, 2025-A) were not downloaded, so their record counts are not known; the large-pool files match the 424B2.

I did not fetch each trust's own submissions list to see its first monthly ABS-EE. 'First pool filing' rests on the filing date (before the 424H and 424B2), the file names ('initialab', 'autoloaninitial') and the 424B2 statement that the initial asset-level data was filed on Form ABS-EE by the date of the prospectus.
EX-103 meanings were read only for 2025-C; the 2024-A and 2025-A EX-103 files were not downloaded.
